title: observability-weekly-2026-09-07
content:
Weekly Observability Notes - 2026-09-07
Owner: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Carlos, Ethan, Maya, Jordan (notes)

1) TL;DR
- Focus this week: tracing sampling rollout (canary), dashboard refresh for cost telemetry, and reducing noisy alerts.
- Canary tracing enabled for 5% of traffic in prod v2 routes; initial latency and trace volume within expected bounds.
- Cost telemetry pipeline P99 token-aggregation was over-estimating for multi-model requests; root cause identified (double-aggregation) and fix merged (PR#3421).

2) Highlights / Wins
- Tracing: Canary sampling enabled for 5% of requests to hosted-api/produce -> traces ingested into Jaeger. End-to-end pipeline verified for large payloads (<= 32k tokens).
- Dashboards: New "Cost per Route" dashboard published (Metrics > Dashboards > Cost) with per-model breakdown and reserved-capacity vs. on-demand view.
- Alerts: Suppressed noisy downstream-redis alerts with a 3-minute cooldown; reduced alert volume by ~40% during spike on 9/5.

3) Metrics snapshot (weekly window 2026-08-31 -> 2026-09-06)
- Trace ingestion rate (sampled): 120k traces/day (after canary), expected at full sampling ~2.4M/day
- Average trace size: 1.2kB
- Dashboard load times (Grafana): median 320ms, p95 1.1s (improved after panel-level caching)
- Cost-telemetry aggregation lag: median 45s, p95 3.8min (target p95 < 2min)
- Alerts: paging incidents down from 18 -> 11 this week (still above target of <=5)

4) Incidents / Postmortem notes
- 2026-09-05 03:14 UTC: Increased alert storm due to Redis client saturating connection pool on the aggregation worker nodes. Impact: transient elevated errors for cost-telemetry writes; dashboards showed delayed numbers.
  - Root cause: new batching change in ENG-5789 inadvertently increased concurrency per worker.
  - Mitigation: reverted batching change (hotfix) and applied connection pool cap.
  - Action items: add load test for aggregation worker (Jira ENG-5831), add connection-pool saturation monitor (alert T-03).

5) Ongoing projects / status
- Tracing sampling rollout (owner: Carlos) - canary at 5% prod (done), expand to 25% next week if no regression. Tasks: add sampling-rate toggle to console, instrument cost-tracking for sampled vs unsampled traces.
- Cost telemetry accuracy (owner: Ethan) - bugfix PR merged (PR#3421) to dedupe aggregations. Deploy to canary on 9/8, monitor for ~48h.
- Dashboard refresh (owner: Maya) - published "Cost per Route" and "Embedding Ops" panels; need UX review from Product (ticket: PD-244).
- Alert rationalization (owner: Jordan) - cleanup noisy alerts, add runbook links. Current plan to reduce paging alerts by 60% over next 3 sprints.

6) Standup snippets (this week)
- Mon 09/01: Carlos - enabled tracing canary; noticed spike in stored span attributes for model-choices; investigating attribute size truncation.
- Mon 09/01: Ethan - rolled back aggregation change after seeing Redis saturation on staging; will add connection pool instrumentation.
- Tue 09/02: Maya - dashboards QA passed; need product review for cost breakdown labels.
- Wed 09/03: Jordan - updated alert cooldowns and added dedupe logic to pager duty integration.
- Thu 09/04: Aisha - ran monthly capacity report; flagged potential cost overrun for res-capacity in eu-west-1 if request mix shifts to embed-heavy workflows.
- Fri 09/05: Team-wide retro on incidents; created follow-ups ENG-5831, ENG-5832.

7) Blockers / Risks
- Query performance for "Cost per Route" panel at full retention may need ClickHouse optimizations; current plan: add pre-aggregated table and TTLs (blocked on infra quota for new table).
- Tracing: high-cardinality tag explosion for model prompts (free-text user input) - risk of storage blowup if sampling expands without scrubbing. Need to finalize scrub/obfuscation rules (see Confluence doc).
- Cost telemetry lag target (p95 < 2min) still unmet; root causes: burst backpressure + occasional Redis saturation.

8) Action items (owners)
- Carlos: expand tracing canary to 25% on 2026-09-14 if no regressions (followup checklist in PR).
- Ethan: deploy dedupe fix to canary 9/8, enable connection pool metrics, create load-test job (ENG-5831).
- Maya: gather Product UX feedback on cost dashboard and merge label fixes (PD-244).
- Jordan: finalize alert runbooks and cut noise by disabling low-signal rules (T-03, T-07).
- Aisha: request infra quota bump for pre-agg ClickHouse table; prepare forecast for res-capacity in eu-west-1.

9) Meeting notes (dashboards sync 2026-09-03)
- Decision: Add model-level cost breakdown to the top-level cost dashboard and a toggle for reserved vs on-demand.
- Action: Product to provide label mapping by 9/10; Eng to add the toggle and wire-up to existing queries.

10) Notes to self / open questions
- How aggressive do we want sampling for conversational contexts where KV cache size is large? (Affects trace size and storage cost)
- Need to finalize retention policy for sampled spans vs. full spans (90d vs 30d?). Recommend storing full traces for 30d and sampled summaries for 90d.

11) Links / refs
- Tracing Sampling Plan (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Tracing+Sampling+Plan
- ENG tickets: ENG-5789, ENG-5831, ENG-5832
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/3421

Next check-in: 2026-09-14
